message:
Various code fixes for warnings from lgtm.com

MuPDF is statically analysed by lgtm.com and it flags up various
small issues, which we address here.

Firstly, let's be consistent about our definition of PATH_MAX.

Second, let's add some repeat inclusion guards on header files.

Thirdly, address lots of cases where we do: size_t z = a * b;
where a and b are ints. We should promote those to size_t BEFORE
the multiplication to avoid overflow.

Fourthly, remove some unnecessary checks. e.g. don't check for
w == 0 when we've already checked that w > 6 earlier. Similarly,
don't check for unsigned things being < 0.

Fifthly, fix my_log2 to avoid relying on shifting bits into the
sign bit position.
